title: Yellowed Filipino Mozzarella Sisig
description: A satvik-friendly Filipino dish featuring mozzarella and nuka-pickle, served in a pandan leaf wrap, this resinous and crumbly sisig is an energizing twist on traditional recipes.

ingredients.name: mozzarella cheese
ingredients.notes: preferably day-old cheese for better texture

instructions: Prepare the pandan leaves by briefly heating them over low flame to make them pliable for wrapping.
In a bowl, mix together the shredded mozzarella cheese, diced nuka-pickle, calamansi juice, salt, black pepper, diced green chili, onion, and garlic until well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as necessary.
Spoon about 1/2 cup of the cheese mixture onto a pandan leaf, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the bottom edge of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the leaf to form a tight wrap.
Repeat with the remaining cheese mixture and pandan leaves.
Serve the sisig immediately, or store in the refrigerator for up to a day before serving.
To serve, slice the wrapped sisig in half and garnish with additional calamansi juice and chili if desired.
